lines.en: Duke Terenor's son, Randolf, has taken over what remains of his father's army.  Men of Veridia, clean up this rabble so we can get on with more important matters.
lines.zh: 特瑞诺公爵之子，兰道夫，接手了他父亲剩余的军队。 维尔迪亚的将士们，干掉这群乌合之众，省得他们耽误我们的正事。
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en:
Casamir. Men like you have no business in the game of war.  We will show you how it works.  Followers of Zanatus, we are to annihilate the enemy.
Your life is mine, Randolf.
You bloody bastard...  to hell with you!
lines.zh: 你这该死的混蛋…… 下地狱去吧！

lines.en: Donari Temple. A concentration of lies.  Show them no quarter. Strip this place of every icon, every text, every sign of life, and burn it to ashes.
lines.zh: 多纳尔圣殿。谎言聚集之所。 无需手下留情。把这里的每一座雕像，每一个字母，每一只老鼠都碾为齑粉，让一切在烈火中化为灰烬！
